name: TokenBrief Data
description: Resolves a crypto token from a ticker, contract address or CoinGecko/CoinMarketCap/DexScreener link and returns live metrics, DEX pairs and rule-based risk flags from CoinGecko and DexScreener (keyless).
_comment: Publish metadata (slug/name/version/executa_type) is read by `anna-app apps publish` / `executa publish`; dev fields (tool_id/type/command/enabled) by `anna-app dev`. The minted production tool_id never goes in this file: app.json#bundled_executas maps the handle `tokenbrief` here, and publish substitutes the minted id into every `bundled:tokenbrief` ref and writes bundle/anna-tool-ids.js. Binary artifacts are built by `pnpm --filter @meitipro1/tokenbrief-executa package:binaries` and uploaded directly at `apps cut` (binary_artifacts track). The npm profile is the alternative if a public npm package is preferred.
